title: A Grand Day Out
text:
The mosque at Cordoba was amazing with the juxtaposition of Arabic and Christian architecture. The old white village built in to cliff face was quaint and made for some good photos. Finally seeing the ancient bridges in Ronda at sunset was simply stunning!
It was a long day but made all the more interesting by our knowledgeable and enthusiastic guide - gracias Enrique!
author: B5802YDgeoffh

title: Golden hour photos
text: Enrique was awesome. Some other travels were slow so we waited some time waiting but overall great experience. Towards the end of the day, being efficient with remaining daylight and getting the golden hour photo would’ve been great
author: 269jungk

title: 3 city tour in Andalusia
text: Enrique was a a very knowledgeable and fun guide.  He’d explain a lot of the stuff about the place in the bus so as to give us more time at the actual spots, had good recommendations for photo spots, coffee places and everything you’d want to know.
author: 837avib

title: A trip to definitely do...
text: Our experience was great and our tour lady Victoria was awesome.  For the the money spent we visit 3 great cities and learn several things.  Thanks for the hospitality and great time! MC
author: Journey55233249621

title: Victoria is amazing plus the trip was the cherry on top
text: Victoria was the best, she saved my life with charger for my phone because it almost dies from all the amazing scenery and views we saw. Lots of driving but very comfy bus
author: aboda374

title: Great day trip from Seville
text:
Victoria was a great guide. She took care of a huge group and ensured everyone understood all instructions in two languages. She is a lovely guide. 

Simon also drove safely and made us reach all spots on time without taking any risks. 

Would highly recommend.
author: 879punamk

title: A recommended tour with a knowledgeable, friendly guide.
text: Antonius has been a very knowledgeable, helpful guide, friendly and organised.
author: Con_Shep321

title: Antonio, the Gentleman of guides
text: Antonio is an excellent guide. His knowledge is very remarkable and appreciated; he manages to share the historical, architectural, cultural, and colloquial facts of each place in an interesting, jovial way that allows you to look at the place from another perspective. Antonio was even attentive to every member of the group, managing to make recommendations and accommodations for whoever needed it. The trip was wonderful!
author: Inspire57715745619

title: Unforgettable experience with great tour guide.
text: The tour is excellent with perfect and clear arrangements. The headset for tour guidance is well-fit among any other tour. The tour is around 15 people and everybody is really nice. The weather in Córdoba and Ronda was perfectly fine for sightseeing. Tour guide Antonio was well prepared, friendly, and full of sense of humour to make us an unforgettable experience here in Spain.
author: cyruspanghk

title: My birthday trip to Saville
text: Antonio was a brilliant tour guide. Very friendly, full of knowledge of the places, great sense of humor which will not bore anyone . Very helpful, accommodating and definitely an asset to the company. Highly recommended and worth the money.. well done Antonio!
